subject: general
question:
A family consists of seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V.

1. Q is the daughter of P.

2. U is the son of R.

3. R is the brother of S.

4. S is the mother of T.

5. V is the sister-in-law of U .

6. P is the father of S.

How is P related to U?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82d006c7e1159436342c6efc92acd7ccf022e61c814cd3f89d91227902c2cb69.png] 

Family tree,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4e1817f9683c1580071a316ce20bb5a0e387eb626a2ec135e1468b2352a5751.png] 

P is Grandfather of U.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 2**”.
